analysis.reason: 3일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 과매도 구간에 진입했으나 MACD 히스토그램은 악화 추세를 지속하며 하락 압력을 강화하고 있다. 5일 저가와 고가가 모두 20일 저가/고가보다 낮아 Lower High 패턴을 형성하며 약세 흐름이 이어지고 있다. 거래량 급증은 하락세 속에서 나타나 추가 하락 가능성을 시사한다.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a 'wait and see' stance for 3 consecutive days. RSI has entered oversold territory, but the MACD histogram continues its worsening trend, intensifying downward pressure. The 5-day low and high are both lower than the 20-day low/high, forming a Lower High pattern and continuing the weak trend. The surge in trading volume during the decline suggests further downside potential.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($539.03) vs SMA5/20/50 ($581.42/$622.11/$602.90) — Below short/mid-term trends, indicating a weak position.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($611.73/$634.37) — Below long-term trends, maintaining strong weakness.
· 52-week position (6.8%) + Approaching 52-week low ($520.26), entering historical low zone.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (46.3→32.1) — Entering oversold, strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1.7886→-10.8765) — Continued worsening, strengthening bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower Band $551.11) — Approaching lower band, suggesting potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($520.26) — Aligns with 52-week low, a strong support zone.
· Swing Resistance ($544.23) — Short-term resistance, potential for rebound attempt if broken.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Lower High) — Confirms continuation of downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (2.90x) — Surge, increased volume amidst decline suggests amplified selling pressure.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) — Potential for short-term rebound due to RSI oversold entry and volume surge, but trend reversal is uncertain due to MACD worsening and Lower High pattern; maintain 'wait and see' condition.
